ama_pay_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = ama_paid_gold value = var:ama_pay_gold }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_gold > 0 } remove_short_term_gold = var:ama_paid_gold }
    set_variable = { name = ama_paid_treasury value = var:ama_pay_treasury }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_treasury > 0 } remove_treasury = var:ama_paid_treasury }
    set_variable = { name = ama_paid_prestige value = var:ama_pay_prestige }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = { value = var:ama_paid_prestige multiply = -1 } }
    set_variable = { name = ama_paid_piety value = var:ama_pay_piety }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = { value = var:ama_paid_piety multiply = -1 } }
    set_variable = { name = ama_paid_barter_goods value = var:ama_pay_barter_goods }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_barter_goods > 0 } remove_barter_goods = var:ama_paid_barter_goods }
}
ama_refund_effect = {
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_gold > 0 } add_gold = var:ama_paid_gold }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_treasury > 0 } add_treasury = var:ama_paid_treasury }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_prestige > 0 } add_prestige_no_experience = var:ama_paid_prestige }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_piety > 0 } add_piety_no_experience = var:ama_paid_piety }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_paid_barter_goods > 0 } add_barter_goods = var:ama_paid_barter_goods }
}
ama_queue_confirmation_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = { name = ama_transaction_ticket value = var:ama_tx_sequence }
    trigger_event = { on_action = ama_confirm_transaction days = 1 }
}
# The caller has already checked native eligibility, ownership, and resources.
ama_create_scoped_regiment_effect = {
    if = { limit = { $SOURCE$ = 1 }
        create_maa_regiment = { type = scope:ama_recruit_type size = 1 check_can_recruit = yes title = $TITLE$ }
    }
    else = { create_maa_regiment = { type = scope:ama_recruit_type size = 1 check_can_recruit = yes } }
}

ama_commit_selected_effect = {
    set_variable = ama_tx_pending
    set_variable = { name = ama_tx_type value = var:ama_candidate }
    set_variable = { name = ama_tx_mode value = var:ama_candidate_mode }
    set_variable = { name = ama_tx_category value = var:ama_candidate_category }
    set_variable = { name = ama_tx_wait value = 3 }
    change_variable = { name = ama_tx_sequence add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_candidate_mode = 1 }
        ama_create_scoped_regiment_effect = { SOURCE = var:ama_candidate_source TITLE = var:ama_candidate_title }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = ama_tx_regiment value = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
        var:ama_tx_regiment = {
            save_scope_value_as = { name = ama_size_before value = maa_size }
            change_maa_regiment_size = { size = 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = ama_before_size value = scope:ama_size_before }
    }
    ama_pay_effect = yes
    set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 1 }
    ama_queue_confirmation_effect = yes
}

        if = { limit = { var:ama_candidate_source = 1 var:ama_candidate_mode = 1

                                    var:ama_target_skirmishers > 0
                                    var:ama_candidate_category = 11
                                    ama_title_create_available_trigger = yes exists = var:ama_candidate_title
                                    var:ama_candidate_title = { holder = scope:ama_owner ama_title_capacity_safe_trigger = yes
                                        var:ama_tc_count_skirmishers < var:ama_tc_plan_skirmishers
                                        can_create_title_maa = abudrar }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        AND = { var:ama_candidate_mode = 2 exists = var:ama_candidate_regiment ama_size_grant_trigger = yes
                            var:ama_target_skirmishers > 0

                                    AND = { scope:ama_owner = { var:ama_candidate_source = 0 var:ama_expand_enabled = 1

                                    }
                                }
                            }

                    set_variable = { name = ama_before_count value = scope:ama_title_before_count }
                }

                ama_commit_selected_effect = yes
                clear_saved_scope = ama_recruit_type

                set_variable = {

                    value = 6
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
ama_step_scored_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            ama_can_check_trigger = yes
            var:ama_remaining > 0
        }
        ama_clear_candidate_effect = yes
        ama_direct_find_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = ama_candidate
                var:ama_candidate_mode = 4
            }
            ama_direct_commit_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    ama_can_check_trigger = yes
                    var:ama_remaining > 0
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        ama_upkeep_ok_trigger = yes
                    }
                    ama_clear_candidate_effect = yes
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                var:ama_create_enabled = 1
                                AND = {
                                    var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1
                                    ama_title_create_available_trigger = yes
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1
                                ama_title_create_available_trigger = yes
                                var:ama_origin_cursor = 0
                            }
                            ama_find_title_create_effect = yes
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_create_enabled = 1
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = ama_candidate
                                }
                            }
                            ama_find_create_effect = yes
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1
                                ama_title_create_available_trigger = yes
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = ama_candidate
                                }
                            }
                            ama_find_title_create_effect = yes
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                var:ama_expand_enabled = 1
                                var:ama_title_expand_enabled = 1
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = ama_candidate
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_title_expand_enabled = 1
                                var:ama_origin_cursor = 0
                            }
                            ama_find_title_expand_effect = yes
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_expand_enabled = 1
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = ama_candidate
                                }
                            }
                            ama_find_expand_effect = yes
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:ama_title_expand_enabled = 1
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = ama_candidate
                                }
                            }
                            ama_find_title_expand_effect = yes
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = ama_candidate
                        }
                        ama_request_effect = yes
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = ama_tx_pending
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = ama_size_pending
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = ama_repl_pending
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                var:ama_status = 10
                            }
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ama_remaining
                            value = 0
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = ama_status
                            value = 3
                        }
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = ama_remaining
                        value = 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = ama_status
                        value = 4
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ama_size_clear_request_effect = {
    remove_variable = ama_size_pending
    clear_variable_list = ama_size_requests_0
    clear_variable_list = ama_size_requests_1
}
ama_size_publish_request_effect = {
    ama_size_clear_request_effect = yes
    save_scope_value_as = { name = ama_size_request_ticket value = var:ama_size_ticket }
    # The opposite datamodel was empty while the current reader was active.
    # Alternating creates a fresh widget even when two requests share a frame.
    if = { limit = { var:ama_size_phase = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_phase value = 1 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_size_requests_1 target = scope:ama_size_request_ticket }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_phase value = 0 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_size_requests_0 target = scope:ama_size_request_ticket }
    }
    set_variable = ama_size_pending
}
ama_size_cancel_effect = {
    ama_rt_cancel_effect = yes
    remove_variable = ama_size_authorized
    if = { limit = { has_variable = ama_size_pending }
        change_variable = { name = ama_size_ticket add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ama_remaining value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 6 }
    }
    ama_size_clear_request_effect = yes
}
ama_size_queue_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_can_check_trigger = yes var:ama_candidate_mode = 2 exists = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_size_attempts < 20 }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_ticket add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_attempts add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_unit value = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_type value = var:ama_candidate }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_source value = var:ama_candidate_source }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_category value = var:ama_candidate_category }
            remove_variable = ama_size_title
            if = { limit = { var:ama_candidate_source = 1 exists = var:ama_candidate_title }
                set_variable = { name = ama_size_title value = var:ama_candidate_title }
            }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_retry value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 8 }
            ama_size_publish_request_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 7 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_remaining value = 0 }
        }
    }
}
ama_request_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_can_check_trigger = yes has_variable = ama_candidate }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_candidate_mode = 2 } ama_size_queue_effect = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:ama_candidate_mode = 3 } ama_repl_begin_effect = yes }
        else = { ama_commit_effect = yes }
    }
}
ama_size_receive_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_size_receive_trigger = yes }
        ama_size_clear_request_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_current value = scope:ama_size_current }
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_max value = scope:ama_size_max }
        set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 4 }
        if = { limit = {
                scope:ama_size_current = scope:ama_size_object.maa_size
                scope:ama_size_max > 0
                scope:ama_size_object.ama_size_next_level_value <= scope:ama_size_max
            }
            set_variable = ama_size_authorized
            ama_commit_effect = yes
            remove_variable = ama_size_authorized
            if = { limit = { has_variable = ama_tx_pending }
                set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 2 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_tx_pending } }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_size_blocked target = scope:ama_size_object }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_skips add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { ama_active_trigger = yes var:ama_remaining > 0 }
                ama_step_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
ama_size_timeout_effect = {
    if = { limit = {
            ama_player_trigger = yes has_variable = ama_size_pending
            exists = scope:ama_size_timeout_ticket
            scope:ama_size_timeout_ticket = var:ama_size_ticket
        }
        ama_size_clear_request_effect = yes
        change_variable = { name = ama_size_ticket add = 1 }
        # One silent retry of the same unit covers a GUI frame that missed the
        # first sample; only the second timeout skips the unit.
        if = { limit = { var:ama_size_retry < 1 }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_retry add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 8 }
            ama_size_publish_request_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { exists = var:ama_size_unit }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_size_blocked target = var:ama_size_unit }
            }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_skips add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = ama_size_timeouts add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_size_last_state value = 5 }
            # A single unreadable unit must not end the whole cycle; three
            # timeouts in one cycle mean the GUI host is not answering at all.
            if = { limit = { var:ama_size_timeouts >= 3 }
                set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 9 }
                set_variable = { name = ama_remaining value = 0 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 11 }
                if = { limit = { ama_active_trigger = yes var:ama_remaining > 0 }
                    ama_step_effect = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ama_find_replace_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_repl_allowed_trigger = yes var:ama_repl_done = 0 }
        save_scope_as = ama_repl_actor
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_base_personal_cap value = maa_regiments_max_count }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_create_enabled = 1 maa_regiments_count < var:ama_repl_base_personal_cap }
            every_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_regular_trigger = yes is_raised = no is_maa_in_combat = no maa_size > 0
                    scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } } }
                save_scope_as = ama_repl_scanned
                scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = scope:ama_repl_scanned }
                    ama_repl_offer_effect = yes
                }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1 NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } }
            every_held_title = { limit = { holder = scope:ama_repl_actor tier >= tier_county
                    ama_tc_cap_value >= 0 ama_rule_owned_count_value < ama_tc_cap_value }
                save_scope_as = ama_repl_scanned_title
                every_owned_title_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_title_regular_trigger = yes
                        is_raised = no is_maa_in_combat = no maa_size > 0
                        regiment_owning_title = regiment_controlling_title
                        scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = ama_repl_scanned
                    scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_title value = scope:ama_repl_scanned_title }
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = scope:ama_repl_scanned }
                        ama_repl_offer_effect = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
ama_repl_snapshot_effect = {
    clear_variable_list = ama_repl_before
    if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_source = 0 }
        every_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_regular_trigger = yes }
            save_scope_as = ama_repl_before_unit
            scope:ama_repl_actor = { add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_repl_before target = scope:ama_repl_before_unit } }
        }
    }
    else = { var:ama_repl_title = {
            every_owned_title_maa_regiment = {
                save_scope_as = ama_repl_before_unit
                scope:ama_repl_actor = { add_to_variable_list = { name = ama_repl_before target = scope:ama_repl_before_unit } }
            }
        } }
}
ama_repl_capture_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_new_count value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_source = 0 }
        every_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_regular_trigger = yes
                scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = ama_repl_before target = prev } } }
            }
            save_scope_as = ama_repl_created
            scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                change_variable = { name = ama_repl_new_count add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = ama_repl_new value = scope:ama_repl_created }
            }
        }
    }
    else = { var:ama_repl_title = {
            every_owned_title_maa_regiment = { limit = {
                    scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = ama_repl_before target = prev } } }
                }
                save_scope_as = ama_repl_created
                scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                    change_variable = { name = ama_repl_new_count add = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_new value = scope:ama_repl_created }
                }
            }
        } }
}

    remove_variable = ama_repl_old remove_variable = ama_repl_new remove_variable = ama_repl_title

ama_repl_abort_effect = {
    save_scope_as = ama_repl_actor
    # Only the captured provisional object may be removed. The original is kept.
    if = { limit = { exists = var:ama_repl_new var:ama_repl_new = { ama_repl_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:ama_repl_new = { destroy_maa_regiment = yes }
    }
    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_last_state value = 3 }
    ama_repl_clear_effect = yes
    set_variable = { name = ama_remaining value = 0 }
}
ama_repl_begin_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_can_check_trigger = yes ama_repl_allowed_trigger = yes var:ama_repl_done = 0
            exists = var:ama_candidate_regiment var:ama_candidate_mode = 3 }
        save_scope_as = ama_repl_actor
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_done value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = var:ama_candidate_source }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_source = 1 } set_variable = { name = ama_repl_title value = var:ama_candidate_title } }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_type value = var:ama_candidate }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_cat value = var:ama_candidate_category }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_last_state value = 3 }
        remove_variable = ama_repl_new
        if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_old = { ama_repl_old_valid_trigger = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old_size value = var:ama_repl_old.maa_size }
            ama_repl_meta_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = ama_repl_base_personal_cap value = maa_regiments_max_count }
            if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_type = 1 var:ama_target_skirmishers > 0
                    var:ama_repl_meta_type = var:ama_candidate_old_type var:ama_repl_meta_cat = var:ama_repl_cat
                    OR = {
                        AND = { var:ama_repl_source = 0 var:ama_create_enabled = 1 maa_regiments_count < var:ama_repl_base_personal_cap can_create_maa = abudrar }
                        AND = { var:ama_repl_source = 1 var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1 exists = var:ama_repl_title
                            var:ama_repl_title = { holder = scope:ama_repl_actor ama_tc_cap_value >= 0
                                ama_rule_owned_count_value < ama_tc_cap_value can_create_title_maa = abudrar }
                        }
                    }
                }
                ama_pick_reset_effect = yes ama_pick_1_effect = yes
                if = { limit = { ama_repl_improvement_trigger = yes }
                    ama_quote_1_effect = yes

ama_direct_find_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_can_check_trigger = yes ama_repl_allowed_trigger = yes }
        save_scope_as = ama_repl_actor
        if = { limit = { var:ama_create_enabled = 1 }
            every_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_regular_trigger = yes
                regiment_owner = scope:ama_repl_actor is_raised = no is_maa_in_combat = no maa_size > 0
                scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } } }
                save_scope_as = ama_direct_scanned
                scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = scope:ama_direct_scanned }
                    remove_variable = ama_repl_title
                    ama_direct_offer_effect = yes
                }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1 NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } }
            every_held_title = { limit = { holder = scope:ama_repl_actor tier >= tier_county }
                save_scope_as = ama_direct_title
                every_owned_title_maa_regiment = { limit = { ama_title_regular_trigger = yes is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                    exists = regiment_owning_title exists = regiment_controlling_title
                    regiment_owning_title = regiment_controlling_title
                    regiment_owning_title = scope:ama_direct_title
                    is_raised = no is_maa_in_combat = no maa_size > 0
                    scope:ama_repl_actor = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_candidate } } }
                    save_scope_as = ama_direct_scanned
                    scope:ama_repl_actor = {
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = scope:ama_direct_scanned }
                        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_title value = scope:ama_direct_title }
                        ama_direct_offer_effect = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
ama_direct_commit_effect = {
    if = { limit = { ama_can_check_trigger = yes ama_repl_allowed_trigger = yes
        var:ama_remaining > 0 var:ama_candidate_mode = 4 exists = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
        save_scope_as = ama_repl_actor
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_source value = var:ama_candidate_source }
        set_variable = { name = ama_repl_old value = var:ama_candidate_regiment }
        remove_variable = ama_repl_title
        if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_source = 1 exists = var:ama_candidate_title }
            set_variable = { name = ama_repl_title value = var:ama_candidate_title } }
        ama_clear_candidate_effect = yes
        if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_old = { ama_repl_old_valid_trigger = yes is_regular_maa_regiment = yes }
            OR = {
                AND = { var:ama_repl_source = 0 var:ama_create_enabled = 1
                    any_maa_regiment = { this = scope:ama_repl_actor.var:ama_repl_old } }
                AND = { var:ama_repl_source = 1 var:ama_title_create_enabled = 1 exists = var:ama_repl_title
                    var:ama_repl_title = { holder = scope:ama_repl_actor
                        any_owned_title_maa_regiment = { this = scope:ama_repl_actor.var:ama_repl_old } } }
            }
        }
            ama_direct_offer_effect = yes
            if = { limit = { has_variable = ama_candidate var:ama_candidate_mode = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_source value = var:ama_repl_source }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_type value = var:ama_candidate }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_mode value = 4 }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_category value = var:ama_candidate_category }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_regiment value = var:ama_repl_old }
                remove_variable = ama_tx_title
                if = { limit = { var:ama_repl_source = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = ama_tx_title value = var:ama_repl_title } }
                set_variable = { name = ama_tx_wait value = 3 }
                set_variable = ama_tx_pending
                change_variable = { name = ama_tx_sequence add = 1 }
set_variable = { name = ama_paid_gold value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = ama_paid_treasury value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = ama_paid_prestige value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = ama_paid_piety value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = ama_paid_barter_goods value = 0 }
var:ama_tx_regiment = { destroy_maa_regiment = yes }
                set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 1 }
                ama_queue_confirmation_effect = yes
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ama_tx_pending } }
            set_variable = { name = ama_remaining value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = ama_status value = 15 }
        }
    }
}
